---
title: "Explore the Data"
---
```{python}
#| include: false
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS
import numpy as np

master_df = pd.read_parquet("data/processed/master.parquet")
decade_order = ["1980s", "1990s", "2000s", "2010s", "2020s"]
master_df["lyric_word_count"] = master_df["lyrics"].dropna().apply(lambda x: len(str(x).split()))
master_df["genre"] = master_df["seed_query"].str.extract(r"^(\w+(?:\s\w+)?)\s+year:")
```

## Lyric Word Count by Decade
```{python}
#| label: wordcount-decade
#| fig-cap: "Lyric word count distributions by decade. The 1990s shows the widest spread."
#| echo: false

fig = px.violin(
    master_df.dropna(subset=["lyric_word_count"]),
    x="decade",
    y="lyric_word_count",
    category_orders={"decade": decade_order},
    color="decade",
    color_discrete_sequence=px.colors.qualitative.Set2,  
    box=False,       
    points=False,      
    height=500,
    labels={
        "lyric_word_count": "Word Count",
        "decade": "Decade"
    },
)

fig.update_traces(opacity=0.8)

fig.update_layout(
    title="Lyric Word Count Distribution by Decade",
    showlegend=False,
    yaxis_range=[0, 100000],
    plot_bgcolor="white",
    paper_bgcolor="white",
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=50, b=0),
)

# subtle gridlines (important)
fig.update_yaxes(showgrid=True, gridcolor="lightgray")

fig.show()
```

## Word Count Over Time
```{python}
#| label: wordcount-time
#| fig-cap: "Mean and median lyric word count by release year. The mean-median gap narrows from the 2000s onward."
#| echo: false

yearly = (
    master_df
    .dropna(subset=["lyric_word_count", "release_year"])
    .groupby("release_year")["lyric_word_count"]
    .agg(["mean", "median", "count"])
    .reset_index()
)
yearly = yearly[yearly["count"] >= 10]

fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=yearly["release_year"], y=yearly["mean"],
    name="Mean", line=dict(color="#6C4FBF", width=2)))
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=yearly["release_year"], y=yearly["median"],
    name="Median", line=dict(color="#D85A30", width=2, dash="dash")))
fig.update_layout(
    height=400,
    xaxis_title="Release Year",
    yaxis_title="Word Count",
    plot_bgcolor="white",
    paper_bgcolor="white",
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=20, b=0),
    legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.05),
)
fig.show()
```

## Top TF-IDF Terms by Decade
```{python}
#| label: tfidf-interactive
#| fig-cap: "Top 15 lyrical terms per decade after stopword removal. Select a decade from the dropdown."
#| echo: false

LYRICS_STOPWORDS = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS).union({
    "oh","yeah","ooh","ah","uh","na","la","hey","ha","woah","whoa","mmm","hm",
    "gonna","wanna","gotta","ain","don","didn","won","can't","couldn","isn",
    "know","like","just","got","get","let","come","go","say","said","want",
    "need","love","baby","time","way","day","night","life","heart","feel",
    "make","take","give","look","away","back","right","ll","ve","re","em",
    "cause","til","bout","chorus","verse","bridge","hook","repeat",
    "x2","x3","x4","lyrics","contributors","genius","embed","outro","intro",
    "translations","english","translation","spanish",
    "que","la","te","el","en","se","yo","da","le","si","mi","pa","tu","lo","es",
})

decade_docs = {
    d: " ".join(master_df.loc[master_df["decade"] == d, "lyrics"].dropna().tolist())
    for d in decade_order
}

vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000,
    stop_words=list(LYRICS_STOPWORDS),
    min_df=2,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    token_pattern=r"(?u)\b[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z]+\b"   # removes numeric junk like 2018 / 10
)

tfidf_matrix = vectorizer.fit_transform(list(decade_docs.values()))
feature_names = vectorizer.get_feature_names_out()

# better palette than pastel
colors = px.colors.qualitative.Set2

traces = []
buttons = []

for i, decade in enumerate(decade_order):
    scores = tfidf_matrix[i].toarray().flatten()
    top_idx = np.argsort(scores)[::-1][:15]

    top_words = [feature_names[j] for j in top_idx][::-1]
    top_scores = [scores[j] for j in top_idx][::-1]

    traces.append(
        go.Bar(
            x=top_scores,
            y=top_words,
            orientation="h",
            marker=dict(color=colors[i % len(colors)]),
            name=decade,
            visible=(i == 0),
            hovertemplate="<b>%{y}</b><br>TF-IDF: %{x:.3f}<extra></extra>"
        )
    )

    visibility = [j == i for j in range(len(decade_order))]
    buttons.append(
        dict(
            label=decade,
            method="update",
            args=[
                {"visible": visibility},
                {"title": {"text": f"Top 15 TF-IDF Terms in the {decade}"}}
            ]
        )
    )

fig = go.Figure(data=traces)

fig.update_layout(
    title={"text": f"Top 15 TF-IDF Terms in the {decade_order[0]}", "x": 0.08},
    height=520,
    showlegend=False,
    plot_bgcolor="white",
    paper_bgcolor="white",
    margin=dict(l=110, r=30, t=110, b=60),
    xaxis_title="TF-IDF Score",
    yaxis_title="",
    updatemenus=[
        dict(
            buttons=buttons,
            active=0,
            direction="down",
            x=0.5,
            y=1.22,
            xanchor="left",
            yanchor="top",
            pad={"r": 10, "t": 0},
            bgcolor="white",
            bordercolor="lightgray",
            borderwidth=1
        )
    ]
)

fig.update_xaxes(
    showgrid=True,
    gridcolor="lightgray",
    zeroline=False
)

fig.update_yaxes(
    showgrid=False,
    automargin=True
)

fig.show()
```

## Artist Country of Origin by Decade
```{python}
#| label: country-decade
#| fig-cap: "Top 8 artist countries per decade. US dominates throughout; Latin countries rise sharply from the 2010s."
#| echo: false

buttons = []
traces = []

for i, decade in enumerate(decade_order):
    subset = master_df[master_df["decade"] == decade]
    top_countries = subset["mb_country"].dropna().value_counts().head(8)
    visible = (i == 0)
    traces.append(go.Bar(
        x=top_countries.values[::-1],
        y=top_countries.index[::-1],
        orientation="h",
        marker_color=colors[i],
        name=decade,
        visible=visible,
    ))
    visibility = [j == i for j in range(len(decade_order))]
    buttons.append(
        dict(
            label=decade, 
            method="update",
            args=[
                {"visible": visibility},
                {"title": {"text": f"Top Artist Countries of Origin in the {decade}"}}
            ]
        )
    )

fig = go.Figure(data=traces)
fig.update_layout(
    title={"text": f"Top Artist Countries of Origin in the {decade_order[0]}", "x": 0.08},
    height=520,
    updatemenus=[
        dict(
            active=0, 
            buttons=buttons, 
            x=0.8, 
            y=1.11,
            xanchor="left", 
            yanchor="top", 
            pad={"r": 10, "t": 0},
            bgcolor="white",
            bordercolor="lightgray",
            borderwidth=1,
            direction="down")],
    xaxis_title="Number of artists",
    plot_bgcolor="white",
    paper_bgcolor="white",
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=60, b=0),
    showlegend=False,
)

fig.update_xaxes(
    showgrid=True,
    gridcolor="lightgray",
    zeroline=False
)

fig.update_yaxes(
    showgrid=False,
    automargin=True
)

fig.show()
```

## UMAP: Decade vs Genre
```{python}
#| label: umap-viz
#| fig-cap: "UMAP embedding space. Toggle between decade and genre coloring to see that genre separates more cleanly than decade."
#| echo: false

import umap

emb_cols = [c for c in master_df.columns if c.startswith("emb_")]
reducer = umap.UMAP(n_components=2, random_state=42, n_neighbors=15, min_dist=0.1)
embedding_2d = reducer.fit_transform(master_df[emb_cols].values)

umap_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "UMAP1": embedding_2d[:, 0],
    "UMAP2": embedding_2d[:, 1],
    "Decade": master_df["decade"].values,
    "Genre": master_df["genre"].values,
    "Track": master_df["track_name"].values,
    "Artist": master_df["artist_name"].values,
})

fig_decade = px.scatter(umap_df, x="UMAP1", y="UMAP2", color="Decade",
    hover_data=["Track", "Artist"], opacity=0.5, height=500,
    color_discrete_sequence=px.colors.qualitative.Pastel,
    category_orders={"Decade": decade_order})
fig_decade.update_traces(marker=dict(size=6))

fig_genre = px.scatter(umap_df, x="UMAP1", y="UMAP2", color="Genre",
    hover_data=["Track", "Artist", "Decade"], opacity=0.5, height=500,
    color_discrete_sequence=px.colors.qualitative.Safe)
fig_genre.update_traces(marker=dict(size=6))

# show decade by default; genre toggled via buttons
for trace in fig_genre.data:
    trace.visible = False

fig = go.Figure(data=list(fig_decade.data) + list(fig_genre.data))
n_decade = len(fig_decade.data)
n_genre = len(fig_genre.data)

fig.update_layout(
    height=500,
    updatemenus=[dict(
        active=0,
        buttons=[
            dict(label="Color by Decade", method="update",
                args=[{"visible": [True]*n_decade + [False]*n_genre}]),
            dict(label="Color by Genre", method="update",
                args=[{"visible": [False]*n_decade + [True]*n_genre}]),
        ],
        x=0.01, y=1.1, xanchor="left", yanchor="top",
    )],
    plot_bgcolor="white",
    paper_bgcolor="white",
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=50, b=0),
)
fig.show()
```
